title: refactor(eval,viz_export,scripts): dedupe report and manifest helpers
body:
- viz_export: drop the duplicated doc-comment sentence on Session; inline
  the self-ignoring escape_json_for_html one-liner with a comment.
- viz_export tests: drop four `contains` asserts implied by the exact
  embedded-dataset assert (the bundle `<\/SCRIPT>` assert stays).
- eval/report: private ReportRow::verdict replaces six inline pass/fail
  ifs; private table_columns shares the column list between the HTML and
  markdown headers.
- eval/tool_harness: remove the unused AgentTaskScope parameter and the
  task group opened only to build it; moonbitlang/async is now test-only.
- eval/prompt_task/harness: one private generic array_field helper
  replaces nine "array field or fail" matches; error texts unchanged.
- eval/prompt_task/harness: bind the combo's relative output path once in
  suite_report_row.
- scripts/md_to_mbt_string: strip a trailing newline with strip_suffix.

Part of a repo-wide simplification round (obvious wins, dedupe, low-value/duplicate test removal). Behavior-preserving; `moon info` shows no `.mbti` change.
